owner_exos: Lizi Quinn (relationship + public-content gate); Jon Quinn supportive
team_name_note: The capstone team sets its OWN space-themed name ASAP (Week 1 gate).
start_date_note: Edwin sets the start date; all weekly gate dates derive from it.
goal: Market and fill the open 135 kg on BLK3 Flight 2 (early 2027, Spaceport America NM) via the SPACEavailable…™ campaign, directing the EXO3 agent fleet.

north_star_targets.high_prob_opportunities: 10× the current weekly run-rate (baseline locked Week 1)

student_outcomes_real_dollars.label: Qualified pipeline $ generated
student_outcomes_real_dollars.definition: Sum of payload-value of opportunities advanced to qualified/handoff (ROM ~$75k/10kg or actual quote).

student_outcomes_real_dollars.label: High-probability close opportunities
student_outcomes_real_dollars.definition: ICP-fit + buying signal (reply/meeting/budget) = handoff-ready. Graded vs the 10× target.

student_outcomes_real_dollars.label: kg of the 135 kg bay advanced → booked
student_outcomes_real_dollars.definition: Payload kg moved into qualified pipeline and ultimately booked.

student_outcomes_real_dollars.label: $ booked
student_outcomes_real_dollars.definition: Actual customer payload bookings attributed to the team.

ai_effectiveness.label: Leverage ratio
ai_effectiveness.definition: Outreach volume + personalization per student-hour vs a manual baseline.

ai_effectiveness.label: AI-assisted reply rate
ai_effectiveness.definition: Reply rate on fleet-personalized outreach vs a generic benchmark.

ai_effectiveness.label: Human-shaped vs AI-executed attribution
ai_effectiveness.definition: Whether student strategy/creative or fleet scale drove each win.

grading_metrics.challenge: AI-only (fleet autonomous) vs Hybrid (students directing fleet) on matched prospect cohorts; the same metrics referee both arms head-to-head.
grading_metrics.cadence: Weekly scorecard (this tracker + Friday digest); week-over-week trend; graded student column.

weekly_gates.title: Onboard & baseline
weekly_gates.gate: Access live; team sets its space-themed NAME; learn EXO3 stack + brand + board; LOCK the 10× high-prob baseline; start ICP. EXOS SITE VISIT (Greenville, TX, 3–4 hrs) scheduled in weeks 1–2 — Jon/Lizi + BD team address the team in person + facility tour.

weekly_gates.title: Prep the race
weekly_gates.gate: ICP + 5 segments finalized; campaign v1 messaging shaped/approved; matched prospect cohorts split; challenge metrics pre-registered. (Exos site visit falls in this weeks-1–2 window if not held in week 1.)

weekly_gates.title: ⚡ CHALLENGE KICKOFF
weekly_gates.gate: AI-only vs Hybrid BOTH live — clock starts. First personalized outreach out (Exos-approved) on both arms.

weekly_gates.title: First pipeline gate
weekly_gates.gate: First qualified opportunities in pipeline; SPACEavailable…™ microsite v1 staged (PR-gated to Lizi).

weekly_gates.title: Full campaign kit
weekly_gates.gate: Deck + social/video + site live-staged; outreach at target weekly volume on both arms.

weekly_gates.title: Pipeline gate A
weekly_gates.gate: Weekly qualified-pipeline $ target hit; first handoffs to Lizi; head-to-head standings visible.

weekly_gates.title: Pipeline gate B
weekly_gates.gate: 10× high-prob run-rate on track; conversion improving week-over-week.

weekly_gates.title: Mid-challenge readout
weekly_gates.gate: Cumulative AI-vs-Hybrid readout; cumulative qualified pipeline $ gate.

weekly_gates.title: Scale
weekly_gates.gate: Sustained qualified pipeline; kg-advanced climbing toward 100 kg.

weekly_gates.title: Convert
weekly_gates.gate: Handoffs converting; booked $ and kg accelerating.

weekly_gates.title: 100 kg push A
weekly_gates.gate: Drive kg-advanced toward the 100 kg reward gate.

weekly_gates.title: 100 kg push B
weekly_gates.gate: Close toward 100 kg; finalize challenge dataset.

weekly_gates.title: Lock results
weekly_gates.gate: Freeze challenge metrics; verify attribution; prep readout.

weekly_gates.title: Results analysis
weekly_gates.gate: AI-only vs Hybrid outcome analyzed; ROI + leverage written up.

weekly_gates.title: Final & selection
weekly_gates.gate: Final presentation + reusable GTM playbook; challenge outcome; Payload Sales Engineer selections.

exos_site_visit: Scheduled within the first two weeks (3–4 hours) — Exos site visit to Greenville, TX: Jon, Lizi + BD team address the team in person, facility tour, and program alignment. Exos hosts.

design_request_loop.purpose: Students get Exo's code-gen on tap to build campaign tools/site, safely.
design_request_loop.gate: EXO BOT is the primary gate — Exo triages and decides design/build requests autonomously so Jon's inbox is never the bottleneck.
design_request_loop.escalation: Exo's call on design review → escalate to Lizi for judgment calls → escalate to Jon ONLY for critical impact or anything that could affect Exo's own functionality/security.
design_request_loop.isolation: Exo generates in the fenced capstone sandbox (spaceavailable-site/ + capstone-tools/) only — never Exos prod/CRM/ERP/MC internals. Every artifact is a reviewed, reversible diff; PR-gated deploy to the static site.
design_request_loop.students: Students REQUEST; Exo GENERATES; humans REVIEW; isolated DEPLOY. No shell/exec on Exos systems.

hosting.decision: SPACEavailable microsite → static host (Cloudflare Pages) as subdomain spaceavailable.exosaero.com; EXO3-aligned (git/content-as-data, WAF, immutable, rollback). Main site can migrate off Squarespace later.
hosting.dns_owner: Lizi has full domain/DNS rights (Jon grants registrar access); Exo gives exact steps + stands up the host.

ip_ownership: Exos owns all capstone deliverables (site, copy, campaign assets, pipeline). Integrate into the UTD docs/MOU; verify UTD capstone terms don't auto-assign to students.

travel_package.transport: 15-passenger van (Exos-provided); ~12-hour drive Greenville TX → Spaceport America NM (drive, not fly).
travel_package.lodging: Group vacation rental / Airbnb (men and women SEPARATE), or hotel block. Consider staying where the Exos team stays (Exos joins for dinner ≥1 night).
travel_package.lodging_options_prestaged: Truth or Consequences NM (~25–30 mi, closest): Holiday Inn Express & Suites, Comfort Inn & Suites I-25 (named 'Near Spaceport America'), Sierra Grande Lodge, or a large T-or-C vacation rental. Las Cruces NM (~55 mi/1 hr, more inventory + dinner options): Hotel Encanto + many chains + group Airbnbs. Rec: closest (T-or-C) for early launch mornings; book EARLY (launch draws crowds). (Jon referenced a 'Rocket City/Rocket Inn' in T or C — Lizi to verify.)
travel_package.food: Per-person per-day food budget (Lizi to set the per-diem cap).
travel_package.owner: Lizi plans/books; Exo pre-staged options above.

commission_credit_rule: A hired Payload Sales Engineer gets ATTRIBUTION CREDIT carried forward for opportunities they sourced during the capstone — but commissions are payable ONLY on FUTURE sales that close BEYOND the capstone period (capstone-period work is graded, not commissioned). Fold into the comp model + MOU.

individual_contribution.purpose: It's a team effort, but EACH person must materially contribute to earn the launch trip AND 1U-payload content. Objective per-person score informs the call; Edwin + Exos JOINTLY make the final material-contribution determination.
individual_contribution.determination: Edwin (UTD) + Exos jointly. Metrics are the objective input; both must affirm eligibility.

metrics_rated.label: Attributed pipeline contribution
metrics_rated.definition: Qualified pipeline $ + high-prob opps traceable to the individual's owned segments/prospects. Direct line from person → real revenue.

metrics_rated.label: Shipped creative/content
metrics_rated.definition: Assets they authored that were APPROVED and shipped (copy, creative, site sections, design-loop requests, social).

metrics_rated.label: AI-leverage effectiveness
metrics_rated.definition: How well their AI-directed campaigns performed vs baseline — the core skill the program teaches.

metrics_rated.label: Consistency & reliability
metrics_rated.definition: Queue tasks completed on time, weekly-gate participation, meeting/site-visit attendance. Free-rider guard.

metrics_rated.label: Instructor + peer assessment
metrics_rated.definition: Edwin + Exos material-contribution judgment + peer contribution input (catches coasting the objective metrics miss).

individual_contribution.eligibility_threshold: Material contributor = individual score >= 60/100 AND affirmed by BOTH Edwin and Exos. Below that OR not affirmed = NOT eligible for the launch trip or any 1U-payload content.

team_1u_payload_reward.description: A 1U payload container (~10x10x10 cm) on the BLK3 flight the team can put content into (names/logo chip, mementos, small flight-safe artifacts). 'Your content goes to space.'
team_1u_payload_reward.team_objective: Unlocks when the team hits its core mission gate — DEFAULT: bundle with the 100 kg booked gate (the team that fills 100 kg earns the launch trip AND the 1U). Jon to confirm the exact bar (could be a distinct qualified-pipeline-$ threshold).
team_1u_payload_reward.individual_eligibility: Only materially-contributing members (per individual_contribution) may place content. Non-contributors get nothing in the 1U.
team_1u_payload_reward.content_constraints: All 1U content subject to Exos flight-safety review (mass/volume/materials per Payload User's Guide) + export screening. No controlled/ITAR items.

source_materials.primary: Exos BLK3 Payload User's Guide (PUG) — the primary/authoritative source for all specs and claims.
source_materials.context: Historical Exos Aerospace + Armadillo Aerospace YouTube videos for context/heritage.
source_materials.attribution_rule: ⚠️ ANY material used from former Armadillo Aerospace (images, video, footage, etc.) MUST credit 'Armadillo Aerospace' (Exos is the commercial successor/buyout of Armadillo). Non-negotiable attribution.
source_materials.guardrail: Public claims still bound by positioning rules (flying since 2018, one of three FAA-licensed reusable, never 'first commercial flight', no overstatement, export-safe). Lizi gates public content.
